01Stears Elections · 2023Content & storytellingThe service →

How a new election tracker beat the BBC on Google

Stears rebuilt Nigeria’s first real-time election tracker for the 2023 general election. My job was to make sure millions of Nigerians could find it, and trust it, when results started coming in.

I led SEO and content strategy, working across editorial, engineering, data and design.

  1. Built the SEO strategy from scratch for searches like “2023 election results” and “presidential candidates Nigeria”.
  2. Designed programmatic candidate profiles: 10,000+ pages covering every candidate for governor, senate and president.
  3. Trained the analyst team, mostly economists, to publish for search, with a framework used across hundreds of articles.
  4. Coordinated editorial, engineering, data and design so pages stayed accurate and fast at peak traffic.

#1on Google for “2023 election results”, above the BBC, CNN and INEC

1.9M+users, 52% of them from organic search

04RemotePass · Ask AI · 2025Launches & go-to-marketThe service →

Everyone was selling AI. We sold the answer.

Ask AI was RemotePass’s newest feature, launched at the peak of the AI craze. Every brand in our category was making the same promise. I led the campaign around a different one: how easy it is to simply ask your workforce data a question.

The insight
HR leaders, our customers and prospects, kept telling us they never had time to explore their own workforce data. Most competitors had not built a story on that.
What we made
One story from the landing page to the announcement video to the sales enablement documents, so buyers heard the same promise at every step.
My role
Led the campaign as Content Marketing Manager: the angle, the story and keeping it consistent across every channel.
Record

MQL performance after the launch. The sales team was flooded with enquiries about the product.

One story, carried across every touchpoint

01Landing pageremotepass.com/ai↗02Announcement videoWatch it on LinkedIn↗03Sales enablementDocuments for the sales team, built on the same story→

Video and visuals by the RemotePass team. My part: the angle, the story and the campaign.

05RemotePass · 2024–25Content & storytellingThe service →

A content engine that turned search into revenue.

RemotePass helps companies hire, manage and pay teams in 150+ countries. When I joined in early 2024, it had just raised $5.5M, but nothing tied content to leads, adoption or revenue. I built its first content strategy across the whole customer journey: how people find us, how they talk to sales, and why they stay.

Q1 2025 alone$192Kin revenue from people who found RemotePass through search and social content, engaged and converted, with no ad spend.
174%rise in organic user acquisition within a year
159%increase in organic traffic in the same year
$500K+pipeline influenced by content, in under a year

Four pillars, one strategy

01 · SEO-driven acquisition

Ranking for what buyers actually search

Search-optimised articles built to capture high-intent traffic where RemotePass had little visibility, from hiring strategy to Saudization rules.

#1 on Google for “how SMEs can compete for top talent”, and on page one for “Saudization requirements for employers”.

02 · Thought leadership

Credibility in a regulated space

Expert insight and HR policy breakdowns that earned mentions in key newsletters and media. I edited pieces for our leadership and brought in outside experts.

An article by CEO Kamal Reggad, edited by me, featured on Wamda; and a RemotePass piece with insight from Toggl’s CEO, Alari Aho.

03 · Product education

Content that keeps customers

Help articles, walkthrough videos and Q&A posts that showed users how to get more out of the platform, to improve retention.

A Q&A video with the product lead on Local Payroll, and the Help Center I helped build.

04 · Sales enablement

Material that closes deals

Pitch decks, one-pagers and customer case studies built with the sales team, to speed up the sales cycle and help close more deals.

Customer stories from Pemo, Podeo and Lean.

06Xofu · 2026Positioning & messagingThe service →

Xofu tracks how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini cite and recommend brands. It was a new category, and buyers had no simple way to see why it mattered to them. I gave the whole story one question to answer.

“Does AI recommend us?”

  1. Rebuilt the positioning around one buyer question: “Does AI recommend us?”
  2. Rewrote the homepage, pricing, services and demo pages.
  3. Packaged pricing into four tiers: Free, Personal, Business and Agency.
  4. Launched the Citation Audit, with engagement-based onboarding emails.
